annotations.title: Emissions rows for a company number or facility ID

description: The rows held for one company number or facility ID, as each source publishes them: source, layer (reported, related or modelled), year, scope as the source states it (blank where it does not), gas or metric, value and unit as filed, the source's own IDs, and the source's Attribution Notice. Values are never added up or converted, and a missing row or a blank value is not a zero. Scope 3 appears only in the French, Taiwanese and Spanish sources. Modelled estimates come only with layer modelled on its own. Inputs: id; id_type (siren, siret, tw_stock_code, nif, abn, au_id_as_filed, ca_bn, qc_sago, ico, rut, il_corp, us_ticker, facility; facility needs source); source, layer, year and scope (comma lists); max_rows (1-200, default 50) and offset page through long replies (next_offset); compact. Available only with an API key whose licence includes Emissions Data; any other call returns a short notice.

compact.description: true leaves out schema and entitlement and gives each row's attribution notice by reference; default false

id.description: Company number or facility ID, e.g. 306138900

id_type.description: What the id is: siren, siret, tw_stock_code, nif, abn, au_id_as_filed, ca_bn, qc_sago, ico, rut, il_corp, us_ticker, facility

layer.description: reported, related or modelled (comma list; modelled only on its own). Default: every layer but modelled

source.description: Only these sources (comma list); one source is required with id_type facility

name: get_emissions
title: Emissions rows for a company number or facility ID
